key.title: Sanitization Key Expression
key.description: JavaScript expression that must resolve to a non-empty string. Quote literal values. For a Cribl Secret, use C.Secret('logtotal_sanitizer_key', 'text').value.

field.title: Field
field.description: Event field whose string value will be sanitized.

rules.title: Sanitization Rules
rules.description: Rules are applied in this order. An explicitly empty list disables all built-in rules.

additionalRules.title: Additional Rules (JSON)
additionalRules.description: Optional JSON array of native LogTotal rule objects. Rules run after selected built-in rules, in array order.

aggressive.title: Aggressive Matching
aggressive.description: Enable broader matching. This can increase coverage, CPU usage, and false positives.
